chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

I became weak regarding prayer and intercourse, so a pot descended upon me from the sky. I ate from it, and it increased my strength by the strength of forty men in fighting and intercourse. And it was Al-Harees (a type of porridge).

key_terms.الصَّلاة: Prayer (specifically night prayer in this context)

ai.seo_question: What food descended from heaven to strengthen the Prophet's physical and spiritual capabilities?
ai.summary: This narration from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the concept of *al-Harees* (often identified as manna or a specific heavenly sustenance) as a divine remedy for physical fatigue, linking the Prophet’s bodily needs to spiritual resilience. In Shia tradition, this event underscores the perfection of the Prophet’s human nature and the miraculous support provided by God to sustain his duties of prayer and family life, serving as a precedent for the Imams' own physical and spiritual fortitude.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-88 According to the same documentation, God’s Prophet (S) said, “

I became too weak to say night prayers and make love. Then a pot of food came down from the heavens from which I ate and regained the strength equal to that of forty men in fighting and intercourse. The food was a form of porridge.”
